name: RELICTUM
description:
About This Game

Explore the Endless Abyss and Uncover Forgotten Truths

RELICTUM is a 2D Metroidvania action adventure where exploration and character progression go hand in hand.

As the Messenger of God, descend into the endless abyss, defeat powerful enemies and bosses, and embark on a journey to fulfill God's command.

Each new ability unlocks previously unreachable areas, revealing hidden paths, secrets, and new challenges.

■ Exploration

Journey through diverse regions, each with its own atmosphere, enemies, and environmental challenges.

Discover hidden passages, uncover secrets, and expand your adventure as new abilities open the way forward.

■ Combat

Face powerful bosses with unique attack patterns.

Master movement, timing, and precision to overcome increasingly difficult encounters.

■ Progression

Collect relics and unlock new abilities that enhance both combat and exploration.

Return to previous areas to discover hidden routes and rewards.

■ Story

Deep beneath the surface lies a forgotten truth waiting to be uncovered.

Meet mysterious characters throughout your journey and piece together the history of the abyss.

Features

  • 2D Metroidvania Action Adventure

  • Explore Diverse Regions

  • Discover Hidden Paths and Secrets

  • Challenging Boss Battles

  • Ability-Based Progression

  • Relic Collection System

  • Full Korean & English Language Support
short_desc: Become the Messenger of God and descend into the endless abyss to defeat powerful enemies and bosses while fulfilling the divine command in this 2D Metroidvania action adventure.
